description.zh: 模板名称，可以通过ListExplorerRegistryModules查询
description.en: The template name. You can call ListExplorerRegistryModules to query available modules.

description.zh: Module所属的工作空间，当前官方RegistryModule的工作空间：alibaba、alibabacloud-automation、aliyun、terraform-alicloud-modules
description.en: The workspace to which the Module belongs. The workspaces for official registry modules are alibaba, alibabacloud-automation, aliyun, and terraform-alicloud-modules.

descriptions.zh: 该 API 主要用于执行 TerraformModule 代码，以实现来创建或更新云资源。使用此 API 前，请确保已正确配置了所有必要的认证信息，并且 Module 对应的 Terraform 代码符合预期的功能需求。
descriptions.en: This API operation is used to execute Terraform Module code to create or update cloud resources. Before using this API operation, make sure that all required authentication information is correctly configured and that the Terraform code corresponding to the Module meets the expected functional requirements.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iacservice execute-registry-module --namespace-name alibaba --module-name vpc --client-token a65451293e64979ba7a4b573950217fe --parameters region_:_cn-hangzhou_,_vpcId_:_vpc-bp145sc90s26q0qbkfb6i_,_functionName_:_filemgr-cn-hangzhou-063fd4aead_,_mountPointsServerAddr_:_063fd4aead-dex50.cn-hangzhou.nas.aliyuncs.com --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
